status: Proposed (2026-10-15): openspec/changes/nebula-skies, docs/mockups/nebula-skies.html. Four skies for the owner to choose between. tools/space/nebula_skies.py paints each into data/space/skies/<id>.json.
_doc: The painted recipes of the nebula skies (openspec/changes/nebula-skies design 4; the stars' classes and colours are data/space/starfield.json's). Directions are [longitude, latitude] in degrees in the system frame: longitude round +y from +z toward +x, latitude up from the planets' plane (xz). Colours are sRGB 0-1; intensities are linear light before the tone map (1 - exp(-colour x exposure)). Layers are painted back to front: band, then each layer in order (glow adds light, dust absorbs what is behind it, core is a round glow). A stroke's path is a list of points joined by smoothed great-circle arcs; width_deg is its half-width at one standard deviation; taper the shares of its length over which it thins in at the start and the end; warp and warp_scale break its edge with noise; grain and grain_scale vary its body. The mesh: base_subdivisions of an icosphere, then split where the colour error at an edge's midpoint is over error_bytes (sRGB bytes), down to min_edge_deg, until vertex_budget. ambient.strength is the linear luminance of the ambient's brightest face (0.13 linear is Homeworld's 40% cap on a display). filaments, filament_scale and filament_power run thin bright strands (ridged noise) through a stroke.

skies.label: A
skies.name: Bloom
skies.look: Bold: a rose and violet cloud sweeping over the station, cut by dark lanes round a gold core, a teal veil above it.

skies.label: B
skies.name: Quiet
skies.for: the Shoals (Tamsin's home space), the darker choice
skies.look: Dark and subtle: a pale galaxy band with brown dust lanes, one faint rust cloud, mostly black and full of stars.

skies.label: C
skies.name: Ember Gate
skies.look: Bold and hot: a red and amber emission cloud torn by black dust, a blue-white cluster burning at its heart.

skies.label: D
skies.name: Verdigris
skies.for: a second system (shown here with a gas giant)
skies.look: Dark and cold: thin teal and sea-green veils over a faint blue band, a pale core, lots of black.

skies.name: Crimson Reach
skies.look: A wide blood-red cloud with ember edges, black lanes across it and a white-hot core.

skies.name: Abyssal Teal
skies.look: Deep sea-green veils over near black, a cold cyan core and thin dark lanes.

skies.name: Violet Storm
skies.look: Storm-purple clouds piled high, magenta at their hearts, a pale lilac core.

skies.name: Golden Veil
skies.look: A thin gold veil across a dark sky, warm amber knots and a bright sun-coloured core.

skies.name: Emerald Rift
skies.look: Two green clouds torn apart by a dark rift, a yellow-green core between them.

skies.name: Ice Halo
skies.look: Pale blue-white wisps round a brilliant blue star, cold and clean, full of stars.

skies.name: Rose Quartz
skies.look: Soft pink clouds with peach edges and a gentle white core: a calm, bright sky.

skies.name: Rust Lanes
skies.look: Brown and rust dust thick with dark lanes, a dim orange glow behind: a gritty sky.

skies.name: Twin Lights
skies.look: A cyan cloud and a magenta cloud meeting, each round its own core.

skies.name: Ashen Void
skies.look: Almost empty: grey-blue dust drifts and a single faint smudge, stars everywhere.

skies.name: Aurora
skies.look: Green and violet ribbons like an aurora, draped along the horizon, a teal core.

skies.name: Solar Furnace
skies.look: A blazing yellow-white heart in orange fire, the brightest sky: battle under a star.

skies.name: Deep Indigo
skies.look: Indigo clouds lit blue from within, a white-blue core and crossing black lanes.

skies.name: Coral Drift
skies.look: Coral and turquoise side by side, like a reef seen from above, a warm core.

skies.name: Iron Shoal
skies.look: Cold steel-blue banks of dust with a pale silver core, a sky for a field of rocks.

skies.name: Amber Tide
skies.look: A long amber swell over deep brown, honey-coloured knots and a soft gold core.

skies.name: Cobalt Drift
skies.look: Cobalt clouds drifting over black, electric blue hearts and a white core.

skies.name: Saffron Haze
skies.look: A saffron haze with rose edges, warm and bright, a cream core low on the horizon.

skies.name: Jade Veil
skies.look: A thin jade veil, sea-green and grey, with a quiet green-white core.

skies.name: Orchid Deep
skies.look: Orchid and plum clouds deep in the dark, violet lanes and a pink-white core.

skies.name: Slate Ember
skies.look: Slate-grey dust with embers glowing through it, a dull red core.

skies.name: Copper Mist
skies.look: Copper and verdigris mist, burnished orange beside green, a bright brass core.

skies.name: Tactical Slate
skies.look: Cold slate-blue haze with steel-grey edges and a pale silver core.

skies.name: Tactical Amber
skies.look: Smouldering amber and copper clouds with brown lanes and a gold core.

skies.name: Tactical Jade
skies.look: Jade and moss veils over a dark green-black, a pale mint core.

skies.name: Tactical Magenta
skies.look: Hot magenta and plum folds, cut by black lanes round a pink-white core.

skies.name: Moss Haze
skies.look: An olive-green haze with amber knots in it and a dim gold core: a murky, close sky.

skies.name: Copper Tide
skies.look: Copper and teal clouds rolling against each other, a hot copper core between them.

skies.name: Cobalt Crown
skies.look: A ring of cobalt clouds round a bright violet-white core, dark lanes through the ring.

skies.name: Jade Lantern
skies.look: Jade-green veils lit from within by a warm yellow lantern of a core.

skies.name: Amber Lull
skies.look: Still amber clouds low on the horizon, soft and wide, a pale honey core: a quiet sky.

skies.name: Pearl Mist
skies.look: Pale pearl-grey mist with faint rose and blue in it, a soft white core.

skies.name: Tidal Glass
skies.look: Clear sea-blue glass with one green current through it and a cool white core.

skies.name: Saffron Ring
skies.look: A saffron cloud curled round a hot white core, rose at its outer edge.

skies.name: Slate Drift
skies.look: Slate-blue drifts thinning into dark, a faint lavender knot: a still, open sky.
